name: soulbuddy-life
description: Plan and review a practical seven-day Christian rule of life with SoulBuddy.

interface.shortDescription: Turn what matters into a thoughtful seven-day plan.
interface.longDescription: Shape realistic commitments around prayer, learning, work, relationships, service, and rest. Check in privately, reflect on the week, and adjust your plan without judgment or spiritual scores.
defaultPrompt: Help me design a realistic seven-day rule of life around faith, work, and family.
Show my current SoulBuddy commitments and help me review today without judgment.
Reflect with me on the past week and suggest one practical adjustment.
